# MNIST regression samples

`mnist-samples.bin` is ten 28×28 u8 images in label order 0–9: the first
held-out test image of each label in Keras' MNIST dataset. Generated by
Applications' `executables/digits/models/train.py`; the dataset SHA-256 is
731c5ac602752760c8e48fbffcf8c3b850d9dc2a2aedcf2cc48468fc17b673d1.
MNIST authors: Yann LeCun, Corinna Cortes and Christopher J. C. Burges.
Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/tensorflow/tf-keras-datasets/mnist.npz

These test fixtures keep dataset provenance and are not runtime model assets.
The small model predicts the selected 5 as 8 (also confirmed independently with
NumPy); the regression pins that actual output instead of implying 100% accuracy.
